room_rent.note: No room rent limit applicable under Plus plan.

icu.note: No ICU sub-limit mentioned for Plus plan.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment stated for Plus plan.

sub_limits.note: Ambulance capped at 1% of SI max ₹2,000/hosp; New Born Baby 10% of SI max ₹50,000; Maternity ₹50,000/delivery; Home Care ₹3,000/day max 15 days; Specs/lens/hearing aids ₹10,000/yr.

maternity.note: Up to ₹50,000/delivery; limited to first 2 deliveries; 36-month waiting period.

cumulative_bonus.note: Maximum cumulative bonus 100% under Plus plan; reduction on claim as per schedule.

restoration.note: Automatic restoration of Base SI when Base SI and Cumulative Bonus exhausted/insufficient; not applicable for RTA, Home Care, Maternity, Infertility, Bariatric, High End Diagnostics.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI; excludes listed conditions.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses covered; donor pre/post-hosp not covered.

modern_treatments.note: No explicit exclusion of modern/robotic treatments.

consumables.note: Reimbursement of listed non-medical/consumable items during hospitalisation; subject to admissible inpatient claim.

global_cover.note: Global Hospitalisation cover not available under Plus plan.

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary excluded for asthma, diabetes, hypertension etc.; alcoholic cirrhosis permanent exclusion; impotency treatment; change-of-gender; adventure sports; no global cover
optional_riders: Medical Second Opinion add-on, Flexi OP Care add-on (OPD cover)
